name: company_invitation_branches
description: Explicit branches of a branch-scoped invitation; all must still be active when it is accepted.
lifecycle: Created with its invitation and never changed.

columns.Meaning: A branch the accepted grant will cover.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, branch_id) REFERENCES branches(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The branch belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: Rows belong to an existing company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, invitation_id) REFERENCES company_invitations(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The invitation belongs to the same company.
Each branch appears once per invitation.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX company_invitation_branches_branch_idx ON public.company_invitation_branches USING btree (company_id, branch_id)
constraints.Purpose: Finds invitations that name a branch.
